title: Multigenerational Family with Boy & Archery Bow, 1930s Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: An outdoor snapshot capturing a multigenerational family gathered on a grassy lawn in a rural, rolling countryside setting. A young boy standing near a woman in a floral patterned day dress holds an archery bow and arrow, surrounded by family members including a tall man in work trousers, young girls, and an elderly patriarch in a dark suit holding a walking stick. Soft lens flare or chemical development artifacts appear along the left and lower center of the print. The verso bears remnants of black scrapbook album paper.
